name: Kishi Mistwalker
source: The drummer for the popular band Prime Ordeals is a friendly and popular character that takes a strong leadership role within the game. Much like setting the pace of a song she sets the tone for the game using her charisma to ease people into the game properly. The real question is will she be able to keep her easygoing attitude when the game gets more chaotic? Or will she crumble under the pressure?
